description: This file contains utility functions related to internationalization, hashing, normalization, and environment variable configurations for a documentation translation or processing system.

methods.name: cacheNamespace
methods.description: Generates a namespace string for caching purposes, based on the workflow version, engine, provider, and model.

methods.name: cacheKey
methods.description: Creates a SHA256 hash-based cache key from namespace, source/target languages, segment ID, and text hash.

methods.name: hashText
methods.description: Returns a SHA256 hash of normalized input text.

methods.name: hashBytes
methods.description: Returns a SHA256 hash of the given byte array.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the beginning and end of the text and collapses multiple whitespace characters into a single space.

methods.name: docsPiProvider
methods.description: Determines the provider for i18n, based on environment variables, defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: docsPiModel
methods.description: Selects the i18n model based on environment variables or defaults based on the provider.

methods.name: segmentID
methods.description: Generates a segment ID string combining relative path and a shortened text hash.

methods.name: splitWhitespace
methods.description: Splits input text into leading whitespace, core text, and trailing whitespace.

methods.name: isWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a byte is a whitespace character.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs an error message and exits the program if the error is non-nil.
